name: JWT Codec
description: Decode, encode and verify JWT tokens.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.
results.expiredHint: The exp claim is earlier than the current time.
results.notYetValidHint: The nbf claim is later than the current time.

hints.input: Decode and verify need a complete token; encode needs a header and a payload.
hints.secret: The secret is sent with the request and never written to browser storage; do not paste production secrets.
hints.algorithm: Only the HMAC-SHA family is supported: HS256, HS384 and HS512.
hints.invalidJson: Header and payload must be valid JSON objects.
hints.output: The decoded view lists the header and the payload; a payload with exp or nbf also gets a time status.

faq.q: Why are only HS algorithms supported?
faq.a: Verifying RS or ES signatures needs public key material, which is out of scope. For non-HS algorithms the tool reports an unsupported-algorithm error instead of pretending the signature is valid.
No. The header and the payload are only Base64URL encoded, not encrypted, so anyone holding the token can read them.
The signature is computed on the server with Tongsuo; the frontend performs no cryptography. The same secret and input always yield the same signature.
